top.line: Our workflow on Odoo 20, built: a keyless agent, a policy check, a signed approval, a narrow broker, a measured grant.
top.para: And what Odoo's default user role quietly allows.

in-short.line: Built in 98 s; a keyless agent; five proposals, four verdicts; the grant measured; the surprise; Enterprise-only agents.

built.line: A separate agent built the MVP on odoo:20.0: snapshot, plan, policy check, signed approval, broker, vault.
built.para: Plus an Agent drafts menu, a provenance tab and a review page.

results.line: Two draft bills allowed and applied; a new supplier refused; one held; one above the limit escalated.
results.para: The agent was over-eager on purpose.

grant.line: Create-only is impossible; posting is a code boundary; the default user role allows email, bank accounts and more.
grant.para: Keep the agent keyless; narrow the broker; re-read and check nightly.

module.line: abp_grant measures a user's grant from Odoo in a tenth of a second, with undo classes, barriers and the enforcer test.
module.para: And proposes record capabilities for the grammar.

native.line: Odoo's agents and MCP are Enterprise-only; automatic triggers write without approval; tools run code; MCP is per tool.
native.para: Credits at a euro each; legacy RPC removed in Odoo 22.

versions.line: The same scripts on Odoo 19 (91 s) and 17 (68 s); on 17 the check failed safe.
versions.para: Version differences belong in the broker.

next.line: A real signature, close the excess, measure native agents, propose capabilities, productise the module.

limits.line: Simulated approval; native agents not run; no email delivered; rule-based extraction.

sources.line: The odoo@AgentiCCells.dinis report, the odoo:20.0 image, and Odoo's documentation on agents, MCP, the API and credits.
